description: This file defines the `Protection` class within the `PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style` namespace. It manages cell protection styles such as locking and hiding in spreadsheet cells, including methods for applying styles, retrieving, setting, and exporting protection-related attributes.

classes.name: Protection
classes.description: Represents protection styles for cells in a spreadsheet, including locking and hiding options, with support for supervisor patterns and style application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Protection class, optionally specifying supervisor and conditional style flags.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Returns the shared protection component from the parent style.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds a style array from provided subcomponents.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies protection styles from an associative array to the object or its shared component.

methods.name: getLocked
methods.description: Retrieves the current 'locked' status, considering supervisor pattern.

methods.name: setLocked
methods.description: Sets the 'locked' status for the protection style.

methods.name: getHidden
methods.description: Retrieves the 'hidden' status, considering supervisor pattern.

methods.name: setHidden
methods.description: Sets the 'hidden' status for the protection style.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the protection style.

methods.name: exportArray1
methods.description: Exports the protection style attributes as an array for further processing.
